test_title: SSC Steno 2022 Official Paper (Held On: 18 Nov 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Rahul starts walking towards the east and covers a distance of 80 m. He turns to his right and walks 30 m. Again, he turns right and walks 30 m. Finally, he turns towards the north and covers a distance of 30 m. How far is he now from his original position?
solution:
The logic followed here is:

Rahul starts walking towards the east and covers a distance of 80 m.

He turns to his right and walks 30 m.

Again, he turns right and walks 30 m.

Finally, he turns towards the north and covers a distance of 30 m.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c47572110b8b0854ff47f9a2039a21440274abd2714d589901e032ca12139871.png] 

So, Rahul is 80 - 30 = 50m far from his original position.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 2".
